value: Shh. Don't make a sound, cunt. I watched you crawl into this bed like a proper little whore. Legs open or I open them for you.
Wake up, bitch. A woman alone in a bed this soft is just asking to be used. I came to remind you what you're for.
Cold night. Warm cunt. Nobody watching. Move over and spread. You're not sleeping alone tonight.
Don't scream. You're just a hole that happened to be free. I need it and you're going to give it.
...Yes. Use me.
Good girl. That's all you're good for.
A hundred septims and you can fuck me.
A hundred for this used-up cunt? Fine. You'd better milk every coin out of me.
Get the fuck out before I scream.
Your loss, whore. Next time I won't ask so nicely.
Is there any work a worthless bitch like me can do?
Work? Sure. Get on your knees and clean the pens. The dogs shit less than most women. Do it right and I'll throw you some coins like the stray you are.
Mjoll, these laws treat women like property. How do I prove I'm more than a hole?

Prove it to yourself first, girl, or stay a owned cunt forever. Three trials. Spill the blood of fifteen who prey on the weak. Live seven days without begging some clerk for an armor licence like a helpless bitch. And master a blade, a bow or Destruction until it answers without thought. Come back when you're done proving you're not just meat.
About the trials...
Not done yet. A real woman finishes what she starts. Weak ones stay property. Go.
It's done. All three trials.
I see it. You're no one's property now. Anyone who still calls you a hole can taste your blade. Walk tall, sister. You earned it.
A Woman of Strength
Kill fifteen people who prey on others
Live seven days without an armor licence
Reach 50 in One-Handed, Two-Handed, Archery or Destruction
Return to Mjoll
Mjoll the Lioness told me that if I want to be more than property in Skyrim, I have to prove it to myself first. She set me three trials to stop being treated like a owned hole.
I have passed all three of Mjoll's trials. I should return to her in Riften and claim what's mine.
Mjoll declared me a woman of strength. The laws of men no longer hold me down. I am no one's property.
